environment.description: IoT gateway deployed on a bare EC2 instance behind a classic ELB with no additional middleware. Express serves responses directly. No CSP headers configured at any layer. MongoDB accepts all field updates without schema-level restrictions beyond defaults.

config.load_balancer: AWS Classic ELB, TCP passthrough mode
config.database: MongoDB 6.0, no field-level encryption, no schema validation rules
config.headers: Only X-Content-Type-Options and X-Frame-Options set by application
config.network: Public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 3000
